what: The table half of the shoot parity gate, recorded once from the old resolver (main._solo_resolve_ai_volley through test/parity/parity_table.gd run(), 200 seeds per scenario) before that resolver is deleted. One JSONL record per seed: {seed, epoch, def_alive, rolls[{kind,count,target,faces,owner}]}.
note: Recorded twice, byte-identical. Not regenerable: the table that wrote it is going away. A new scenario needs its record before the resolver is deleted.
